maya: Quick sync: we're blind to batch decisions in traces during model fanout. can't tie CPU/cost spikes to batching choices. Proposal: small "batch-shim" at ingest that propagates batch_id, mode(latency|throughput|fallback), size_hint, window_ms. stamp into root span and response structured logs.
raj: agree. keep metrics low-cardinality: emit rw.batcher.decision{mode,model,route} but do NOT add batch_id as metric label.
ahn: sampling: 100% for batch decisions, sample token-deltas/cache-hits at route-configurable rate (default 1%). sampled token events should be counts/fingerprints only, no raw tokens.
nina: privacy: default ON for hosted, OFF for private installs. add config observability.batch_shim.enabled and use pii-scrubber on any sampled payload.
kevin: storage: don't index batch_id globally. index only sampled_diagnostic traces for 48h or keep a short TTL lookup table. also create daily rollup table batch_rollup_{day} aggregated by model/route/mode.
maya: implementation notes: edge-sidecar will set headers X-RW-BATCH-ID, X-RW-BATCH-MODE, X-RW-BATCH-SZ, X-RW-BATCH-WIN and stamp root span tags. pseudocode: ```// edge handler
b = batcher.peek(req)
req.h.set("X-RW-BATCH-ID", b.id)
span.root.tag("rw.batch_id", b.id)
metric.emit("rw.batcher.decision", 1, {mode:b.mode, model:req.model, route:req.route})
if rand()<sampling_rate: emit_event("rw.token_delta", scrub(token_delta))
```
raj: I'll draft a tiny RFC for the header/proto and add config knobs per-deployment. ahn+raj will prototype in staging. nina will add scrubber rules. kevin will draft indexing policy. target: first pass in 2 sprints.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for edge-proxy v3.16 to staging at 3659999988 :rocket:
